item.title: The Hunt for Giant Primes: Why Mersenne Numbers Hold the Records
item.description: Every largest known prime since 1952 has been a Mersenne number. Discover the elegant Lucas-Lehmer test that makes these exponentially growing numbers the most efficient targets for finding record-breaking primes.
